```yaml
name: Auto-approve workflows for first-time contributors

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Determine if contributor is first-time
        id: first_time_contributor
        run: |
          PR_COUNT=$(git log --author="$(git show -s --format='%ae')" --pretty=count)
          echo "::set-output name=is_first_time::$(test $PR_COUNT -le 1 && echo true || echo false)"

      - name: Check for ok-to-test label
        id: check_label
        run: |
          LABELS=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json labels --jq '.labels[].name')
          echo "::set-output name=has_ok_to_test::$(echo "$LABELS" | grep -q "ok-to-test" && echo true || echo false)"

      - name: Approve workflows if conditions met
        if: ${{ steps.first_time_contributor.outputs.is_first_time == 'true' || steps.check_label.outputs.has_ok_to_test == 'true' }}
        run: |
          gh pr review ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --approve
```
